lesson: The system is consistently attempting to front-run reversals against strong momentum, failing to account for the lack of Wyckoff distribution or accumulation structures before entry. All four losses resulted from entering counter-trend or overextended positions without waiting for a confirmed shift in market structure (SMS).
adjustment: Mandate a confirmed 15m market structure break (MSB) following a sweep of liquidity before initiating any position, regardless of RSI exhaustion or EMA rejection signals.
methodology_flag: Trust RSI-based mean reversion signals less; prioritize SMC liquidity sweeps over oscillator-based exhaustion.
